name: Report on the Defias Brotherhood
summary: At Stormwind Keep, a report on the Defias Brotherhood carries the findings of a long investigation to the royal court. City Architect Baros Alexston entrusts it to the adventurer who uncovered the conspiracy.

sections.title: A Dispatch for the Throne
sections.body: City Architect Baros Alexston prepared a report for Stormwind's leaders after a long investigation into unrest in Westfall and nearby lands. He entrusted the document to the adventurer who unraveled the conspiracy. The report is carried to Stormwind Keep, where it is meant to accompany a personal audience about the conspirators' schemes and the danger they pose to the kingdom.

sections.title: Reception at the Keep
sections.body: King Varian Wrynn is away on a diplomatic journey when the courier reaches the throne room. Royal advisors and the regency governing for the boy-king Anduin receive the report in his place. They commend the courier for stopping VanCleef's plans. Lady Katrana Prestor is among the court figures present as the warnings reach the regency.

faq.q: What is the Report on the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: The Report on the Defias Brotherhood is an official briefing by Baros Alexston, gathering intelligence on Edwin VanCleef, his subterranean army, and the wider Defias conspiracy against Stormwind.
Baros Alexston, Stormwind's City Architect, prepared the report. He once worked alongside the stonemasons before they broke away to form the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why am I delivering this to Stormwind Keep?
faq.answer: Baros Alexston believes the adventurer who uncovered the conspiracy deserves to present the findings to the throne and earn royal recognition for protecting the realm.

faq.q: Does King Varian read the report?
faq.answer: No. King Varian Wrynn is away on a diplomatic voyage when you reach Stormwind Keep. His court and regency receive the report in his place.

angles.text: Delivering the report brings the long struggle to secure Westfall and warn Stormwind's leaders of the insurrection at its borders to the royal court.
As a human of the realm, you carry a report that reflects the unresolved conflict between Stormwind's noble house and the stonemasons who rebuilt the city.
